yt_title: Airtable vs Stackby: same limits, 58% less 💸 #Shorts
yt_description:
Airtable or Stackby? We compared Airtable Team with Stackby Business on databases, apps, workflows, interfaces and AI, then priced both for a team of 3.

Airtable Team: $720 a year ($20/seat/month × 3, billed annually).
Stackby Business: $299 a year for 3 users.
That's $421 saved every year, 58% less.

Feature by feature
• Records per base / database: Airtable 50,000 · Stackby 50,000
• Automation runs / month: Airtable 25,000 · Stackby 25,000
• Interfaces & portals: Airtable Included · Stackby Included
• API columns (live data): Airtable Scripts & extensions · Stackby Included
• Sync: Instagram, YouTube, Meta Ads: Airtable Not built in · Stackby Included
• AI: Airtable Credit-capped · Stackby Included
• 3 users, billed yearly: Airtable $720 / year · Stackby $299 / year · Business

Stackby plans (3 users included, billed annually)
• Economy: $149/year for 3 users (7,000 records per database, 1,000 automation runs / month, interfaces, AI & API columns)
• Business: $299/year for 3 users (50,000 records per database, 25,000 automation runs / month, interfaces, AI, API columns & sync)
• Pro: $449/year for 3 users (100,000 records per database, 100,000 automation runs / month, custom domain & enterprise access)
Every plan includes AI, API columns and interfaces/portals. Business and Pro add sync connectors for Instagram, YouTube, Meta Ads and more; Pro adds enterprise access.

👉 Try Stackby free: https://stackby.com/signup
